versions.changelog:
Major upgrade with new features and improved performance:

- Added multiple organization modes (simple, standard, deep, archive)
- Introduced date-based archiving and customizable date formats
- Added progress display, operation history, and undo support
- Implemented intelligent suggestions for file organization
- Enhanced safety with auto-backup, conflict detection, and permission checks
- Performance boost with multi-threading and optimized output (including color support)
- Expanded and improved documentation with quickstart, advanced use, and FAQ
